notes: The hand-drawn Ranger is gone. You were right - it was ugly, and I had even flagged that risk before shipping it, which makes it worse. Home now uses the actual Ford Ranger render, cropped out of the reference screen you sent, with the PRND text painted out and the frame trimmed. Tail lights are lit in the render itself, so only the states a still image cannot show are drawn on top - reverse wash and indicator chevrons - and those sit beside the truck rather than pixel-aligned onto it, so swapping the image later does not break them. Still no 3D engine: a live model on the launcher home screen of this chip is the same risk that got Lottie pulled, and a static render costs nothing per frame. If you want a sharper truck, the crop is only 206 pixels wide in your mockup so it is upscaled - open the Sketchfab model, angle it how you want, screenshot it at full size and drop the PNG in the folder, and I will swap it in.
